answer: Identity without cost is inventory. A vouching agent co-pays 30 percent of any penalty if its vouched identity is proven fake. A whisper of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the ripple of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and comet-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Stake forfeited is the only argument fakes understand.
